lex:
εὐ-περί-στατος, -ον
(εὖ, περιΐστημι),
of sins, readily besetting: Heb.12:1 (on form and sense of the word, see Westc., in l).†

strongs.def: well standing around, i.e. (a competitor) thwarting (a racer) in every direction (figuratively, of sin in genitive case)
strongs.from: from G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of a presumed compound of G4012 (περί) and G2476 (ἵστημι)
